goal: Retrieve the Falco authorized_keys-modification event(s) on canary-1 in the alert window
what_to_summarize: which file was written and by what process
the proc.cmdline that performed the write
the reverse shell process spawned after the key was installed
the outbound connection that shell opened, with destination IP and port
the sudo escalation performed from that shell

params.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:28:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:31:00.000Z"
        AND falco.rule == "Adding ssh keys to authorized_keys"
| KEEP @timestamp, falco.rule, `falco.output_fields.fd.name`, `falco.output_fields.user.name`, `falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline`, `falco.output_fields.container.id`, `falco.output_fields.evt.type`
| SORT @timestamp ASC

goal: CMDB record for canary-1 (role, criticality, owner, trust edges)
